message.content: The minor allele (T) of rs7412—commonly referred to as the APOE ε2 allele—has a minor‑allele frequency of roughly **10 %** in European populations. In other words, about one in ten individuals carries the T allele at this locus. The exact frequency can vary slightly among sub‑populations (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europeans), but most large‑scale studies (e.g., 1000 Genomes, gnomAD) report a frequency in the 8–12 % range.
